title: Dimensional Analysis in Finite Ring Continuum

rows.label: A1

rows.label: A2

rows.label: A3

rows.label: A5

rows.label: A6

The fundamental units are the Carrier's horizons. Falsifiers: a fifth algebraically independent relation within the quartet lattice; a measured variation of the dimensionless ratios of the constants.

rows.label: E2

C2.name: FRC.Dimensions.U_mul
C2.doc: 10:C2 — the product of labels: `U_{r,s} U_{r',s'} = U_{r+r', s+s'}`.

C2.name: FRC.Dimensions.Uhom_injective
C2.doc: 10:C2 — the label group is `D_p`: the homomorphism is injective (`κ ≥ 1`).

C2.name: FRC.Dimensions.graded
C2.doc: 10:C2 — the grading on the fibres `A_p^{(r,s)} = F_p U_{r,s}` (Mathlib's `grade`): the product of two homogeneous quantities lies in the fibre of the sum of their domains.

C3.name: FRC.Dimensions.fibre_add
C3.doc: 10:C3 — fibrewise addition: two quantities of one domain add within the fibre, `q U_{r,s} + q' U_{r,s} = (q + q') U_{r,s}`.

C3.name: FRC.Dimensions.coeff_sum_single
C3.doc: 10:C3 — the component of a sum of homogeneous quantities in the fibre `a` is the sum of the summands of domain `a`: the sum is homogeneous of domain `a` exactly when every other component vanishes.

C3.name: FRC.Dimensions.monomial_units
C3.doc: 10:C3 — the domain of a monomial with integer exponents, in the label group: `∏ U_{a_j}^{k_j} = U_{Σ k_j a_j}`.

C3.name: FRC.Dimensions.single_mem_grade_iff
C3.doc: 10:C3 — the neutral-domain criterion: a nonzero homogeneous quantity `c U_a` lies in the fibre `b` iff `a = b`; so a monomial with nonzero coefficient is a neutral-domain invariant iff `Σ k_j a_j = 0` in `D_p`.

C3.name: FRC.Dimensions.Dom.pow_eq
C3.doc: 10:C3 — the domain of a power is the multiple of the label: `U_{r,s}^k = U_{kr, ks}`; so the domain of a monomial `∏ U_{a_j}^{k_j}` is `Σ k_j a_j`, and the monomial is neutral iff that sum is `(0, 0)`.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.dilation_character
C5.doc: 10:C5 — the dilation character on the lift: for a primitive `m` (of order `p − 1`), `m^{−r} = 1` iff `(p − 1) ∣ r`; on a window `|r| ≤ H < 2κ < p − 1` this forces `r = 0` — in-window invariance under every dilation is `r = 0`.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.invariant_iff
C5.doc: 10:C5, 10:D3 — invariance under the pushforward `u ↦ εu` of every unit `ε` of `C_{4κ}` holds exactly on the cardinal pair `{0, 2κ}`: `ε = −1` is always admissible and forces `2u = 0`; conversely every unit is odd, so it fixes the half-period.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.quarter_turn_law
C5.doc: 10:C5, 10:D2 — the quarter-turn labels `±κ` are fixed or exchanged by the pushforward exactly as `ε mod 4 ∈ {1, 3}`: `ε κ ≡ (ε mod 4) κ (mod 4κ)`, so `εκ = κ` for `ε ≡ 1` and `εκ = 3κ = −κ` for `ε ≡ 3`; the flag subgroup is preserved and its generator fixed or conjugated, as the residue quarter-turn `±i` is.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.sigma_twist
C5.doc: 10:C5 — the `σ`-twisted lift of the pushforward: for `4 ∣ ε − σ` (so `σ = ±1` as `ε ≡ 1, 3 (mod 4)`), `ε(s + jκ) ≡ εs + σ jκ (mod 4κ)` — the integer formula `(r, s; j) ↦ (r, εs; σ(ε) j)` is a lift representative of the action `u ↦ εu` on the realized coordinate `u = s + jκ`, exact as a congruence.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.half_period_invariant_not_neutral
C5.doc: 10:C5 — the sharpness of the window bound: the half-period label `(0, π)`, `π = 2κ`, is invariant under every re-presentation and is not neutral.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.flag_moves
C5.doc: 10:C5 — the flagged label `(0, 0; 1)` moves under `ε = −1`: its realization `κ` goes to `3κ ≠ κ`, so the flag-free restriction of window covariance cannot be dropped.

C5.name: FRC.Dimensions.witnesses13
C5.doc: 10:C5 — the boundary witnesses on `F_13` (`κ = 3`, `2⁻¹ = 7`, `5⁻¹ = 8`): the naive character is ill-defined on the modular projection (`7³ ≠ 7¹⁶` although `3 ≡ 16 (mod 13)`), and the would-be temporal character fails composition (`5² ≡ 1` in `Z_12^×` while `(5⁻¹)² ≠ 1` in `F_13`).

C6.name: FRC.Dimensions.meridian_transport
C6.doc: 10:D2, 10:C6 — meridian transport onto the flag: the two periods interfere, `([L][T]^κ)^p = I_q` — the meridian component wraps (`p ≡ 0 (mod p)`) while the phase component advances by `pκ = 4κ·κ + κ ≡ κ (mod 4κ)`; for every shell.

C6.name: FRC.Dimensions.meridian_transport
C6.doc: 10:D2, 10:C6 — meridian transport onto the flag: `([L][T]^κ)^p = I_q` — the meridian component wraps, `p ≡ 0 (mod p)`, and the phase component advances by `pκ = κ + κ·4κ ≡ κ (mod 4κ)`; for every capacity.

D1.name: FRC.Dimensions.four_domains
D1.doc: 10:D1 — the four labels `[L], [L]⁻¹, [T], [T]⁻¹` are pairwise distinct (`κ ≥ 1`): the orbit is the four-domain structure.

D1.name: FRC.Dimensions.deltaC_involutive
D1.doc: 10:D1 — `δ_C` is an involution: `δ_C²(D) = I_q (I_q D⁻¹)⁻¹ = D`.

D1.name: FRC.Dimensions.deltaC_generators
D1.doc: 10:D1 — `δ_C` carries `[L] ↦ [p]` and `[T] ↦ [E]`: the dual horizons are the flag-crossed images of the primal charts, while `δ_S` is flag-free.

D1.name: FRC.Dimensions.Dom.inv_inv
D1.doc: 10:D1 — the chart duality `δ_S : D ↦ D⁻¹` is an involution.

D1.name: FRC.Dimensions.deltaC_involutive
D1.doc: 10:D1 — the crossed duality is an involution, `δ_C(δ_C D) = D`, and carries `[L] ↦ [p]`, `[T] ↦ [E]`.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.order_four_iff
D2.doc: 10:D2 — the elements of order four of `D_p` are exactly `I_q = (0, κ)` and `I_q⁻¹ = (0, 3κ)`: every one lies in the time-exponent factor.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.unique_order_four_subgroup
D2.doc: 10:D2 — `D_p` contains exactly one subgroup of order four, `⟨I_q⟩ = {1, I_q, I_q², I_q³}`.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.no_flag_of_space
D2.doc: 10:D2 — no flag of space: `4r = 0` in `C_p` forces `r = 0` (`p` an odd prime), so the meridian factor contributes no element of order four.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.order_two_iff
D2.doc: 10:D2 — the one element of order two of `D_p` is the half-period `I_q² = (0, 2κ)`.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.meridian_transport
D2.doc: 10:D2, 10:C6 — meridian transport onto the flag: the two periods interfere, `([L][T]^κ)^p = I_q` — the meridian component wraps (`p ≡ 0 (mod p)`) while the phase component advances by `pκ = 4κ·κ + κ ≡ κ (mod 4κ)`; for every shell.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.quarter_turn_law
D2.doc: 10:C5, 10:D2 — the quarter-turn labels `±κ` are fixed or exchanged by the pushforward exactly as `ε mod 4 ∈ {1, 3}`: `ε κ ≡ (ε mod 4) κ (mod 4κ)`, so `εκ = κ` for `ε ≡ 1` and `εκ = 3κ = −κ` for `ε ≡ 3`; the flag subgroup is preserved and its generator fixed or conjugated, as the residue quarter-turn `±i` is.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.flag_order_four
D2.doc: 10:D2 — `I_q² = [T]^π`, the half-period `π = 2κ`, and `I_q, I_q², I_q³ ≠ 1`: the flag has order four.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.no_flag_of_space
D2.doc: 10:D2 — no flag of space on a framed shell: `4r = 0` forces `r = 0` (`2 ≠ 0` and no zero divisors), so the meridian factor contributes no element of order four; and `2r = 0` forces `r = 0`.

D2.name: FRC.Dimensions.order_four_13
D2.doc: 10:D2 — the elements of order four of `D_13 = C_13 × C_12` are exactly `(0, 3)` and `(0, 9)`: the flag and its conjugate, both in the time factor (exhaustive over the `156` labels).

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.operator_four_cycle
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the operator four-cycle behind the lift, on the shell `F_p`, `p = 4κ + 1`: `F = i W` with `i = −g^κ` has `F² = J` and `F⁴ = 1` (6-fourier's B7, `Fourier.shell_relations`), and `F² = J ≠ 1` since `J` exchanges the index `1` with `−1 ≠ 1` on a cycle of length `4κ ≥ 4`: the operator has order four, its square the parity.

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.record_injective
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the record map is injective: an isomorphism of `Z_4` onto the flag subgroup.

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.record_range
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the image of the record map is the flag subgroup `⟨I_q⟩ = {1, I_q, I_q², I_q³}`.

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.record_mem_parity_iff
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the chart shadow: `I_q^s` lies in the parity subgroup `{1, I_q²}` exactly when `s` is even — the quotient of the record by `⟨I_q²⟩ = ⟨[T]^π⟩` returns `s mod 2`, and the kernel of the forgetting is `{id, J}`.

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.crossing_order_four
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the Carrier face of the lift: the crossing quantum `ħ` with `ħ² ≡ −1 (mod Ω)` has `ħ⁴ = 1` and `ħ² ≠ 1` — two crossings the half-turn, four the identity, never two (`Ω > 2`).

D3.name: FRC.Dimensions.record_values
D3.doc: 10:D3 — the record `s ↦ I_q^s` on `s = 0, 1, 2, 3` takes the four values `1, (0, κ), (0, 2κ), (0, 3κ)` of the flag subgroup, and returns to `1` at `s = 4`; its values at `0` and `2` are the parity subgroup, the chart shadow of the four-cycle.

D6.name: FRC.Dimensions.flagged_readings
D6.doc: 10:D6 — the flagged readings sit one capacity step above their counts: `[E] = [T]^{κ−1}` and `[p] = [L]^{−1}[T]^κ` on the realized lattice; `[S] = [E][T] = I_q` and the phase counts are neutral, `[E][T][ħ]⁻¹ = 1`, `[p][L][ħ]⁻¹ = 1`.

D6.name: FRC.Dimensions.flag_inaccessible
D6.doc: 10:D6 — the flag is horizon-inaccessible: no in-window label `(r, s)` with `|s| ≤ H < κ` realizes `I_q = (0, κ)`, since `s ≡ κ (mod 4κ)` with `|κ − s| < 2κ` and `κ − s ≠ 0` is impossible; at `κ ≤ H < 2κ` the chart monomial `[T]^κ` itself is the flag.

D6.name: FRC.Dimensions.flagged_readings
D6.doc: 10:D6 — the flagged readings: `[E] = (0, κ − 1)` one capacity step above the count, `[p] = (−1, κ)`, the action `[S] = [E][T] = I_q`, and the phase counts neutral, `[E][T] I_q⁻¹ = 1`, `[p][L] I_q⁻¹ = 1`.

D6.name: FRC.Dimensions.flag_inaccessible13
D6.doc: 10:D6 — the flag is horizon-inaccessible on `𝔽₁₃`: no label with `|r|, |s| ≤ 2 < κ = 3` (the representatives `r ∈ {11, 12, 0, 1, 2}`, `s ∈ {10, 11, 0, 1, 2}`) is `I_q = (0, 3)`, while at `H = 3` the label `(0, 3)` itself is the flag.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.action_identity
E2.doc: 10:E1, 10:E2 — one crossing, one action: with the dual horizons the crossed images `p_P = ħ/ℓ_P`, `E_P = ħ/t_P`, the quartet satisfies the single identity `ℓ_P p_P = t_P E_P = ħ`.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.quartet_param
E2.doc: 10:E2 — the relation lattice has rank `4 − 1 = 3`: a quartet `(ℓ, t, p, E)` of scales with `ℓ, t ≠ 0` satisfies `ℓp = tE` exactly when it is `(ℓ, t, ħ/ℓ, ħ/t)` for the one value `ħ = ℓp` — three free scales, in bijection with the primitive triple `(ℓ_P, t_P, ħ)`.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.pairing_closure
E2.doc: 10:E2 — pairing closure: the cross-domain relations reduce to `c` and `ħ` — the two faces of `c` agree, `ℓ/t = E/p`; the mixed products are their monomials, `|k_B| = p t = ħ/c` and `ℓE = ħ c`.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.normalisation
E2.doc: 10:E2 — the normalisation to the totality, `G = ħ c / m_P² = ℓ² c³ / ħ`, and the recovery of the free scale, `ℓ² = G ħ / c³`, `t = ℓ/c`, `p = ħ/ℓ`, `E = ħ c/ℓ`: `(c, ħ, G)` and `(ℓ_P, t_P, ħ)` carry the same three scales, monomially in one direction and by the square of `ℓ` in the other.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.index_two
E2.doc: 10:E2 — the sublattice `⟨c, ħ, G⟩` has index two in the free lattice on `{ℓ_P, t_P, ħ}`: the exponent matrix of `c = ℓ t⁻¹`, `ħ`, `G = ℓ⁵ t⁻³ ħ⁻¹` has determinant `−2`.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.scale_from_constants
E2.doc: 10:E2 — the positive root closes the bijection: for `c, ħ, G > 0` there is exactly one `ℓ > 0` with `ℓ² = G ħ / c³`.

E2.name: FRC.Dimensions.exponent_faces
E2.doc: 10:E2 — the exponent vectors over `(ℓ, t, p, E)`: the two faces of `c` differ by the relation `ℓ − t + p − E` (`ℓp = tE`), as do the two faces of `ħ`; `ℓE = ħ c` and `p t = ħ/c` as exponent identities.

E3.name: FRC.Dimensions.cancellation
E3.doc: 10:E3 — the cancellation identity `|k_B| c = ħ` at the unit face, `(p t)(ℓ/t) = ℓ p`; mass derived, `m_P = p/c = E/c²`; the temperature horizon `Θ_P = E/|k_B| = E c/ħ`.

E3.name: FRC.Dimensions.quartet_flags
E3.doc: 10:E3 — the flag positions of the quartet `(ℓ_P, t_P, p_P, E_P)` are `(0, 0, 1, 1)` — the dual horizons `p_P = ħ/ℓ_P`, `E_P = ħ/t_P` are the crossed images `[p] = I_q[L]⁻¹`, `[E] = I_q[T]⁻¹` — and every quartet relation closes on the flag component: `ħ = ℓ_P p_P` at `0 + 1 = 1`, `c = ℓ_P/t_P` at `0`, `c = E_P/p_P` at `1 − 1 = 0`, `|k_B| = p_P t_P` at `1`, `G = ℓ_P² c³/ħ` at `−1` (the inverse flag, `[G]`).

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.G_unique
E4.doc: 10:E4 — the linear defining congruence: on the Carrier chart (`4S + 1 = 0`, `2 ≠ 0`), `2G + 1 = 0` has the unique solution `G = 2S`, the half-cycle.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.root_pair
E4.doc: 10:E4 — each quadratic defining congruence has exactly two roots, the pair `{x, −x}`: if `x² = a` with `x ≠ 0` (`2 ≠ 0`), then `y² = a` iff `y = x` or `y = −x`, and `−x ≠ x`.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.linkage
E4.doc: 10:E4 — the linkage derived at pair level: `k_B² = −2` and `2c² = 1` give `(k_B c)² = −1`, so `k_B c ∈ {ħ, −ħ}` for any root `ħ` of `−1`: `{±k_B}{±c} = {±ħ}`.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.residues_exist
E4.doc: 10:E4 — existence on every admissible Carrier: `Ω = 4S + 1 ≡ 1 (mod 4)` makes `−1` a square unconditionally; `S` even is `Ω ≡ 1 (mod 8)`, which makes `2` and hence `2⁻¹` squares; `−2` is the product. So the four defining congruences are solvable, and `G = 2S` is their linear solution.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.h_form
E4.doc: 10:E4 — the `h`-form: `h = 2π ħ` with `2π = 4S ≡ −1` on the Carrier chart, so `h = −ħ` — the root pair of `−1` is `{ħ, h}`.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrier233
E4.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the Carrier `Ω = 233` (`S = 58`, admissible: `58` even, `58 ≡ 1 (mod 3)`, `233` prime): `G = 116 = 2S`, `ħ = 89`, `k_B = 124`, `c = 159`, `h = 144 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage `k_B c = −ħ`, `G = −c²`, `G² = 4⁻¹`, `ħ⁴ = 1`, and `ħ c = k_B G` (the monomial on the `k_B` residue); the partner root `109 = −124` fails the linkage; decided in `ZMod 233`.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrierLab
E4.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561` (`S = 602 140`, admissible): `G = 1 204 280 = 2S`, `ħ = 18 688`, `k_B = 1 880 160`, `c = 171 106`, `h = 2 389 873 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage, `G = −c²`, `G² = 4⁻¹`, `ħ⁴ = 1`, `ħ c = k_B G`; decided in `ZMod 2408561`.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.G_unique
E4.doc: 10:E4 — the linear pin: on a framed Carrier `Ω = 4S + 1`, `2G + 1 = 0` has the unique solution `G = 2S`, the half-cycle.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.root_pair
E4.doc: 10:E4 — the root pair: if `x² = a` with `x ≠ 0` then `y² = a` iff `y = x` or `y = −x`, and `−x ≠ x`; each quadratic defining congruence has exactly two roots on a framed Carrier.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.linkage
E4.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the linkage at pair level and the pair consequences, on a framed Carrier: from `2G + 1 = 0`, `2c² = 1`, `ħ² = −1`, `k_B² = −2`: `(k_B c)² = −1`, so `k_B c = ħ` or `k_B c = −ħ` (`{±k_B}{±c} = {±ħ}`); `G = −c²`; `(2G)² = 1`; `ħ⁴ = 1`; and `(ħ c)² = −2 G²`, the monomial face.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrier233
E4.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the Carrier `Ω = 233` (`S = 58`): `G = 116 = 2S`, `ħ = 89`, `k_B = 124`, `c = 159`, `h = 144 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage `k_B c = −ħ`, `G = −c²`, `ħ c = k_B G` (the monomial on the `k_B` residue), and the partner `109 = −124` fails the linkage.

E4.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrierLab
E4.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561` (`S = 602 140`): `G = 1 204 280`, `ħ = 18 688`, `k_B = 1 880 160`, `c = 171 106`, `h = 2 389 873 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage, `G = −c²` and `ħ c = k_B G`.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.pair_consequences
E5.doc: 10:E5 — the pair consequences, by field arithmetic from the defining congruences: `G = −c²`, `G² = 4⁻¹`, `ħ⁴ = 1`, `(k_B c)² = −1`, and `(ħ c G⁻¹)² = −2`, so the monomial `ħ c G⁻¹` lands in the pair `{±k_B}`.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.sign_assignments
E5.doc: 10:E5 — representative inertness: the quadratics are sign-blind, and with `k_B c = −ħ` at one assignment the sign assignment `(σ_c, σ_ħ, σ_k)` keeps the linkage iff `σ_ħ = σ_c σ_k` — so exactly the four assignments with `σ_ħ = σ_c σ_k` are admissible (`σ_c, σ_k` free), a `(Z/2)²`; every identity of `pair_consequences` holds on each, and the `ħ`-flip relabels within `{ħ, h}`.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrier233
E5.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the Carrier `Ω = 233` (`S = 58`, admissible: `58` even, `58 ≡ 1 (mod 3)`, `233` prime): `G = 116 = 2S`, `ħ = 89`, `k_B = 124`, `c = 159`, `h = 144 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage `k_B c = −ħ`, `G = −c²`, `G² = 4⁻¹`, `ħ⁴ = 1`, and `ħ c = k_B G` (the monomial on the `k_B` residue); the partner root `109 = −124` fails the linkage; decided in `ZMod 233`.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrierLab
E5.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561` (`S = 602 140`, admissible): `G = 1 204 280 = 2S`, `ħ = 18 688`, `k_B = 1 880 160`, `c = 171 106`, `h = 2 389 873 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage, `G = −c²`, `G² = 4⁻¹`, `ħ⁴ = 1`, `ħ c = k_B G`; decided in `ZMod 2408561`.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.linkage
E5.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the linkage at pair level and the pair consequences, on a framed Carrier: from `2G + 1 = 0`, `2c² = 1`, `ħ² = −1`, `k_B² = −2`: `(k_B c)² = −1`, so `k_B c = ħ` or `k_B c = −ħ` (`{±k_B}{±c} = {±ħ}`); `G = −c²`; `(2G)² = 1`; `ħ⁴ = 1`; and `(ħ c)² = −2 G²`, the monomial face.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrier233
E5.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the Carrier `Ω = 233` (`S = 58`): `G = 116 = 2S`, `ħ = 89`, `k_B = 124`, `c = 159`, `h = 144 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage `k_B c = −ħ`, `G = −c²`, `ħ c = k_B G` (the monomial on the `k_B` residue), and the partner `109 = −124` fails the linkage.

E5.name: FRC.Dimensions.carrierLab
E5.doc: 10:E4, 10:E5 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561` (`S = 602 140`): `G = 1 204 280`, `ħ = 18 688`, `k_B = 1 880 160`, `c = 171 106`, `h = 2 389 873 = −ħ` satisfy the defining congruences, the linkage, `G = −c²` and `ħ c = k_B G`.

E9.name: FRC.Dimensions.minimality
E9.doc: 10:E9 — the minimal admissible pair is `(13, 233)`: `(κ, S) = (3, 58)` is admissible, no pair with `S < 58` is (for `S < 58`, `p² < Ω` forces `κ ≤ 3`), and the counterfactuals — dropping the mod-3 clause admits `(13, 193)` (`S = 48`), dropping `κ > 1` admits `(5, 41)` (`S = 10`), and `κ = 2` gives the composite `9`.

F2.name: FRC.Dimensions.mechanical_domains
F2.doc: 10:F2 — the mechanical and gravitational domains from `[E] = I_q[T]⁻¹` and `[v] = [L][T]⁻¹`: `[m] = [E][v]⁻² = I_q[L]⁻²[T]`, `[a] = [v][T]⁻¹`, `[F] = [m][a] = I_q[L]⁻¹[T]⁻¹`, `[p] = [m][v] = I_q[L]⁻¹` (the flagged wavenumber `I_q[L]⁻¹` again), `[S] = [E][T] = I_q`, `[P] = [E][T]⁻¹ = I_q[T]⁻²`, `[pressure] = [F][L]⁻² = I_q[L]⁻³[T]⁻¹`, `[G] = [F][L]²[m]⁻² = I_q⁻¹[L]⁵[T]⁻³`, and the quartet face `[ħ][c][m]⁻² = [G]`; mass is derived, not primitive.

F2.name: FRC.Dimensions.geometric_conversions
F2.doc: 10:F2 — the geometric conversions are flag-free: `[Għ/c³] = [L]²`, `[Gm/c²] = [L]`, `[Gm/c³] = [T]`, `[Gρ_m] = [T]⁻²`, `[Gρ_E/c⁴] = [L]⁻²` (the curvature domain), and the Compton closure `[mc/ħ] = [L]⁻¹`.

F2.name: FRC.Dimensions.realized13
F2.doc: 10:F2, 10:F3, 10:F4, 10:G3 — the derived domains realized on `𝔽₁₃` (`κ = 3`, the flag `(0, 3)`): `[m] = [E][v]⁻² = (11, 4)`, `[a] = (1, 10)`, `[F] = [m][a] = (12, 2)`, `[p] = [m][v] = (12, 3) = I_q [L]⁻¹`, `[S] = [E][T] = I_q`, `[P] = (0, 1)`, `[G] = [F][L]²[m]⁻² = (5, 6)`; the geometric conversions `[Għ/c³] = [L]²`, `[Gm/c²] = [L]`, `[Gm/c³] = [T]`, `[Gm/r³] = [T]⁻²`; `[Θ] = [E][k_B]⁻¹ = [a]` and the Unruh closure; the phase exponent `[E][T][ħ]⁻¹ = 1`; kinetic energy `[m][v]² = [E]`; `Q + Q²` inhomogeneous, `[L] ≠ [L]²`; `F/a = [m]`, flagged.

F3.name: FRC.Dimensions.temperature_domain
F3.doc: 10:F3 — temperature carries the acceleration domain: with `[k_B] = [p_P t_P] = I_q[L]⁻¹[T]`, `[Θ] = [E][k_B]⁻¹ = [L][T]⁻² = [a]`, flag-free; and the Unruh combination `[ħ a / (c k_B)] = [Θ]` closes flag-free.

F3.name: FRC.Dimensions.realized13
F3.doc: 10:F2, 10:F3, 10:F4, 10:G3 — the derived domains realized on `𝔽₁₃` (`κ = 3`, the flag `(0, 3)`): `[m] = [E][v]⁻² = (11, 4)`, `[a] = (1, 10)`, `[F] = [m][a] = (12, 2)`, `[p] = [m][v] = (12, 3) = I_q [L]⁻¹`, `[S] = [E][T] = I_q`, `[P] = (0, 1)`, `[G] = [F][L]²[m]⁻² = (5, 6)`; the geometric conversions `[Għ/c³] = [L]²`, `[Gm/c²] = [L]`, `[Gm/c³] = [T]`, `[Gm/r³] = [T]⁻²`; `[Θ] = [E][k_B]⁻¹ = [a]` and the Unruh closure; the phase exponent `[E][T][ħ]⁻¹ = 1`; kinetic energy `[m][v]² = [E]`; `Q + Q²` inhomogeneous, `[L] ≠ [L]²`; `F/a = [m]`, flagged.

F4.name: FRC.Dimensions.equal_crossing_flag_free
F4.doc: 10:F4 — count-valued comparisons are flag-free: the ratio of two labels of equal crossing degree has crossing degree zero — the flag enters unitful measures only.

F4.name: FRC.Dimensions.comparison_examples
F4.doc: 10:F4, 10:G3 — the examples: the phase exponent `[E][T]/[ħ]` neutral; the gravitational frequency `[Gm/r³] = [T]⁻²` flag-free; and the scope witness — `F/a = [m]` has crossing degree `1` (the degrees `1` and `0` are not equal), so the equal-crossing-degree hypothesis cannot be dropped.

F4.name: FRC.Dimensions.realized13
F4.doc: 10:F2, 10:F3, 10:F4, 10:G3 — the derived domains realized on `𝔽₁₃` (`κ = 3`, the flag `(0, 3)`): `[m] = [E][v]⁻² = (11, 4)`, `[a] = (1, 10)`, `[F] = [m][a] = (12, 2)`, `[p] = [m][v] = (12, 3) = I_q [L]⁻¹`, `[S] = [E][T] = I_q`, `[P] = (0, 1)`, `[G] = [F][L]²[m]⁻² = (5, 6)`; the geometric conversions `[Għ/c³] = [L]²`, `[Gm/c²] = [L]`, `[Gm/c³] = [T]`, `[Gm/r³] = [T]⁻²`; `[Θ] = [E][k_B]⁻¹ = [a]` and the Unruh closure; the phase exponent `[E][T][ħ]⁻¹ = 1`; kinetic energy `[m][v]² = [E]`; `Q + Q²` inhomogeneous, `[L] ≠ [L]²`; `F/a = [m]`, flagged.

G1.name: FRC.Dimensions.local_recovery
G1.doc: 10:G1 — local recovery of classical exponent bookkeeping: for `4κ > 2H`, two conventional pairs `(r, s)`, `(r', s')` with `|r|, |r'|, |s|, |s'| ≤ H` and the same modular label are equal.

G1.name: FRC.Dimensions.embed_injective
G1.doc: 10:G1 — the embedding is injective on `Z³` (triangular with unit diagonal): the crossing degree carries the mass exponent exactly.

G1.name: FRC.Dimensions.realize_faithful
G1.doc: 10:G1 — windowed faithfulness of the realization: on `|r|, |s| ≤ H` with `2H < κ` and `|j| ≤ 1`, two full labels with the same realization `(r, s + jκ)` are equal — `r` from the meridian factor, and `(j − j')κ ≡ s' − s (mod 4κ)` with `|j − j'| ≤ 2`, `|s − s'| < κ` forces `j = j'` and then `s = s'`; beyond the window the sector saturates, `4 • I_q = 0`.

G1.name: FRC.Dimensions.recovery13
G1.doc: 10:G1, 10:G3 — local recovery on `𝔽₁₃` at `H = 5`: the `121` conventional pairs `|r|, |s| ≤ 5` have distinct modular labels, `12 > 10`.

G2.name: FRC.Dimensions.window_ladder
G2.doc: 10:G2 — the window ladder `2√κ < κ/2 < κ < 2κ`, by integer squares: `16κ < κ²` iff `κ > 16`, and `κ/2 < κ < 2κ` for `κ > 0` — nested for every `κ ≥ 17`, failing for the toy `κ = 3`; the coherence identity `(2√κ)² = 4κ = p − 1` and the totality closure `(2√S)² = 4S = Ω − 1`.

G2.name: FRC.Dimensions.window_ladder
G2.doc: 10:G2 — the window ladder by integer squares: `(2√κ)² = 4κ < (κ/2)² = κ²/4`, i.e. `16κ < κ²`, holds for `κ = 17, 387, 602 140` and fails for `κ = 3`; the coherence identity `(2√κ)² = 4κ = p − 1` and the totality closure `4S = Ω − 1` on the laboratory Carrier.

G3.name: FRC.Dimensions.examples13
